verdict.rationale: Bolt integrates with Supabase, which explicitly provides 'Authentication services' as part of its hosted backend (bolt-docs-22, bolt-docs-8, bolt-docs-27), implying Bolt-built apps can add sign-up/login via this integration. However, there's no evidence of Bolt itself scaffolding auth UI/flows, specifying support for social providers, or documenting an end-to-end login/sign-up template—only that Supabase (a third party) offers auth as a service. missing for 10: explicit documentation of scaffolded sign-up/login UI, named social provider support (Google, GitHub, etc.), and any first-party or community example showing this generated end-to-end.
